title: CoP name verification result received
description: Confirmation of Payee (CoP) name verification result received event. This event is generated when a third-party customer requests name verification from scheme and it lands to provider Form3. Form3 give back the result to the third-party and also sends a webhook notification to Pismo who then sends this event to the client The [Confirmation of Payment](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/post-cop-verification) endpoint generates the name verification request.

name_verification_id.title: Name verification ID
name_verification_id.description: Name verification request ID (webhook data->id). This is a 36-character UUID.

actual_name.title: Actual name
actual_name.description: Actual name associated with the account

reason_code.title: Reason code
reason_code.description:
Verification result reason code.
`AC01` - No account with the given account number
`ACNS` - Account does not support Confirmation of Payee
`ANNM` - String does not match the account name
`BAMM` - Close match to the account name. Account type is Business when Personal was indicated
`BANM` - Match to the account name, but account type is Business when Personal was indicated
`CASS` - Account has been switched to a different organisation
`IVCR` - Invalid secondary customer reference data
`MBAM` - Close match to the account name
`OPTO` - Account opted out of Confirmation of Payee
`PAMM` - Close match to the account name. Account type is Personal when Business was indicated
`PANM` - Match to the account name, but account type is Personal when Business was indicated
`SCNS` - Organisation doesn't own the passed sort code

reason.title: Reason
examples: Close Match with the name of the payment counterparty

bank_id.title: Bank ID
bank_id.description: ID of bank holding the account
